candidates.title: Lithium-Ion Battery Cell Manufacturing Plant Setup in India
candidates.lead: Lithium-ion cells are the energy building block of the electric and digital economy. Electric two-wheelers, cars, buses, grid-scale energy storage, telecom towers, inverters, power tools, laptops, and smartphones all depend on them. India still imports almost all of the cells it uses, while demand from electric mobility and renewable energy storage is rising sharply.
